Returns consumer posture assessment, spending regime classification, confidence level, savings stress indicator, credit dependency metric, 150-word narrative summary, dominant risk factor, and agent-actionable implications. Consolidates 8 FRED data lookups plus LLM synthesis into a single call for rapid assessment of retail sector exposure, recession probability, and consumer credit risk.
data.reasoning: Summary is too technical and feature-focused. Missing formal description. Improved summary is clearer and action-oriented. New description explains inputs (FRED indicators), processing (LLM synthesis), outputs (posture, spending regime, risk factors, narrative), and use cases (retail exposure, recession assessment)—enabling AI agents to understand the operation's purpose and when to invoke it for consumer economic analysis.
